scope: regular-season games (All-Star Game and Commissioner's Cup Championship excluded, as ESPN's season stats do), pooled across seasons; correlations per player

weighting.scheme: per-game season weights (recency tilt); weighted Pearson, Kish effective-N used for significance

espn_totals_check.note: Kept games reconciled against ESPN's own Regular Season totals (PTS/REB/AST/3PM). Non-empty 'mismatches' means our game set has drifted from ESPN's.
